name: Grace Bay Club
insider_take: Grace Bay Club sits on what's consistently ranked as the world's #1 beach – a 12-mile stretch of powdery white sand meeting impossibly turquoise waters with zero seaweed and virtually no waves.
whats_special: This intimate all-suite resort pioneered luxury hospitality in Turks & Caicos back in 1993. The property features only 59 suites spread across three distinct areas, ensuring an exclusive feel. Grace Bay Beach boasts some of the clearest water in the Caribbean due to the island's unique coral reef barrier that sits 2 miles offshore, creating a natural lagoon effect.
pro_tip: Book the Oceanfront Junior Suites during conch season (October-April) to witness local fishermen harvesting conch right from the beach at sunrise – a cultural tradition dating back centuries.
dont_miss: The resort's weekly conch bar setup on Grace Bay Beach, where local conch is prepared fresh steps from where it's harvested. Also explore the nearby Smith's Reef, one of the Caribbean's best shore snorkeling spots, accessible via a short walk along the beach.
pros: Prime location on world-renowned Grace Bay Beach
Luxury oceanfront suites with private terraces
Multiple award-winning restaurants and beach bar
Full-service spa and exclusive beach club access
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
